definitions.explanation: A department or office within an organization that handles secretarial functions, typically managing the schedule, correspondence, and affairs of senior executives or officials.

examples.japanese: {秘書室|ひしょしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{秘書室|ひしょしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{管理|かんり}している→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧。
examples.english: The president's schedule is managed by the secretarial office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{秘書室|ひしょしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦{行|おこな}って→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please handle visitor reception through the secretarial office.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{秘書|ひしょ}→秘書：05502_hisho⟧ (secretary) and ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room, office, department). In Japanese organizations, {秘書室|ひしょしつ} functions as a formal department rather than just a physical room.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秘書室|ひしょしつ}⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧ — head of the secretarial office
- {秘書室|ひしょしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ — to be assigned to the secretarial department
- {秘書室|ひしょしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ — to go through the secretarial office (for requests)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{秘書|ひしょ}→秘書：05502_hisho⟧ — secretary
- {秘書課|ひしょか} — secretarial section (an alternative organizational name, essentially the same function)
- ⟦{総務部|そうむぶ}→総務部：23789_soumubu⟧ — general affairs department (a broader department that sometimes includes secretarial functions)
- ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧ — reception desk (handles visitor greeting, a different function)

USAGE:
In Japanese companies, the {秘書室|ひしょしつ} typically serves the ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧ (president) and ⟦{役員|やくいん}→役員：11329_yakuin⟧ (executives). In government, it serves the ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧ (minister) or ⟦{知事|ちじ}→知事：03467_chiji⟧ (governor). The department acts as a gatekeeper controlling access to senior leaders.
